sections.title: Our story
sections.html:
AT KOKOFRESH

FROM THE KITCHENS OF KARNATAKA

Rasam - or saaru as it is known in Karnataka - is one of the simplest and most comforting dishes in South Indian cooking. Unlike heavier gravies, rasam is meant to be light, aromatic, and restorative, especially when made with a traditional rasam powder.

For generations, Karnataka households have prepared rasam using carefully balanced spice blends that highlight pepper, cumin, and coriander rather than overwhelming heat.

Our Karnataka Traditional Rasam Powder follows that same philosophy - whole spices sourced from farms, gently roasted, stone-ground in small batches, and packed fresh to preserve the delicate aroma that defines authentic rasam.

WHY KARNATAKA RASAM POWDER IS SPECIAL:

  • Pepper-forward warmth rather than chilli-heavy heat
  • Balanced spices designed for light, drinkable rasam
  • Minimal ingredients for clarity and digestibility
  • Traditional roasting that preserves aroma

OUR PROMISE:

Whole spices are sourced directly from farms - never mixed with fillers. Each batch is roasted carefully and ground in small batches only after orders are placed to preserve freshness and authentic flavour.

NO HIDDEN INGREDIENTS:

Many commercial rasam powders add lentils, fillers, or excessive chilli powder to create bulk. We don't. Ever.

OUR RASAM POWDER IS:

  • Made only with whole spices
  • Pepper-forward for traditional Karnataka flavour
  • Stone-ground to preserve natural oils and aroma
  • Free from fillers, additives, and preservatives
  • Packed fresh for maximum aroma

From Karnataka's kitchens to your table. No shortcuts. No additives. Just authentic, home-style goodness.

sections.title: Ways to enjoy
sections.html:
CLASSIC RASAM

Boil with tamarind water, tomatoes, and add tempering for a comforting, soulful rasam.

RICE MIX

Mix rasam with hot rice and a drizzle of ghee for a simple, soothing meal.

SOUP STYLE

Enjoy as a light digestive drink after meals — warm, spiced, and comforting.

FLAVOUR BOOST

Add a pinch while making curries or dals to enhance aroma and taste.

IF AROMA REDUCES:

  3. Store tightly sealed to retain remaining freshness
